overview_description.description: Reibus is an online marketplace for buying and selling metals that connects businesses and simplifies metal transactions. The company connects buyers with a network of metal suppliers and offer logistics services to ensure smooth metal transportation. Reibus showcases features like anonymous buying, real-time leads for sellers, and transparent shipping.

about_short_description.short_description: Reibus is a B2B marketplace for buying and selling metals that connects businesses and simplifies metal transactions.

product.name: Reibus Marketplace
product.description: A digital platform for buying and selling various metals including steel, aluminum, and alloys, connecting buyers and sellers anonymously.

product.name: Reibus Logistics
product.description: A freight service managing the shipping of metal products across North America with real-time quotes, shipment tracking, and carrier network management.

product.name: Reibus Claims Management
product.description: A process for handling claims related to nonconforming or damaged metal materials supplied through Reibus.

product.name: Reibus U
product.description: An educational platform offering courses on steel industry fundamentals and metal marketplace knowledge.

product.name: Freight Carrier Network Service
product.description: A service connecting truck owners with metal shipment opportunities to optimize freight utilization.
